title: Volumetric Processing of Structured Light Integrated in Glass
summary: Light with complex structures in polarization, phase and amplitude, has attracted a lot of attention in a broad range of applications and fundamental studies in classical and quantum optics. Along with the increased interest in structured light comes a need for efficient modulation platforms operating simultaneously for many modes.
